initial_state.tagline: Capture and share the world's moments

alicechen.name: Alice Chen
alicechen.bio: Seattle. Bikes, mountains, the occasional render. Photos are mine, bugs are also mine.

bmartinez.name: Bob Martinez
bmartinez.bio: Bread, goalkeeping, and a cat that is not mine but visits. Northstar by day.

carolnk.name: Carol Nakamura
carolnk.bio: Engineering manager. Dog photos, mostly. The dog is Miso.

lena.frames.name: Lena Marchetti
lena.frames.bio: Street and documentary photographer, Seattle and wherever the bus goes. 35mm, mostly. Prints available, DM me.

okafor.shoots.name: Tunde Okafor
okafor.shoots.bio: Landscape and night sky. Long exposures, cold hands. Workshops in the Cascades every autumn.

driftwood.cafe.name: Driftwood Cafe
driftwood.cafe.bio: Neighbourhood cafe in Fremont. Single origin pour-overs, cardamom buns from Sunrise Bakery, one very patient cat. Open 7 to 4.

vertical.world.name: Vertical World Climbing
vertical.world.bio: Climbing gym, Ballard and Redmond. New sets every Tuesday. Day passes, memberships, youth teams. Chalk up.

roam.with.rin.name: Rin Takahashi
roam.with.rin.bio: Slow travel, one country a season. Currently: Portugal. Next: I do not know yet and that is the point.

pnw.trailheads.name: PNW Trailheads
pnw.trailheads.bio: Trail conditions, permit reminders and the view from the top. Community submitted. Leave no trace, take every photo.

miso.the.shiba.name: Miso
miso.the.shiba.bio: Shiba inu. Carol's dog. Professional loaf. Not food motivated, but I will consider your offer.

northstarhq.name: Northstar
northstarhq.bio: Deterministic simulation, Seattle. Office dogs, launch cakes and the whiteboard wall. Careers at http://northstar.example/

p-4101.author: okafor.shoots
p-4101.image: Milky Way over Mount Rainier, Sunrise visitor centre, 2am
p-4101.text: Three hours of waiting for the cloud to clear and then this for four minutes. Mount Rainier from the Sunrise side, 2am, 25 seconds at f/2.8. Worth every frozen finger. #milkyway #mountrainier #nightsky #longexposure #pnw

p-4102.author: driftwood.cafe
p-4102.image: Latte art rosetta in a blue ceramic cup on a wooden counter
p-4102.text: Monday morning rosetta, still slightly lopsided, still delicious. Cardamom buns landed at 7:05 and were gone by 9. Fremont, we see you. #latteart #fremont #seattlecoffee #cafelife

p-4103.author: carolnk
p-4103.image: Shiba inu asleep upside down on a grey couch, paws in the air
p-4103.text: Miso has chosen violence against the concept of dignity. Sunday. #shibainu #dogsofinstagram #ballard

p-4104.author: miso.the.shiba
p-4104.image: Close-up of a shiba inu side-eye with a tennis ball just out of frame
p-4104.text: I saw the ball. I am choosing not to acknowledge the ball. This is a power move. #shiba #sideeye #notfoodmotivated

p-4105.author: lena.frames
p-4105.image: Black and white: a man in a raincoat waiting under the Pike Place Market sign in heavy rain
p-4105.text: Pike Place, 6:40am, before the market opens and before the tourists. He waited eleven minutes and nobody came. 35mm, Tri-X pushed to 1600. #streetphotography #seattle #blackandwhite #35mm #pikeplace

p-4106.author: vertical.world
p-4106.image: Climber mid-dyno on a bright orange overhang route, chalk cloud in the air
p-4106.text: NEW SET in Ballard: the orange cave project is up and it is rude. V7ish, three moves, one of them a full commit. Tag us when you send. Sets reset every Tuesday. #climbing #bouldering #ballard #newset #vertical

p-4107.author: alicechen
p-4107.image: Gravel bike leaning against a moss-covered log on a forest road, fog between the trees
p-4107.text: Iron Horse trail, 6am, fog in the trees and nobody else for two hours. 62 miles and the only bug I found was in my head. #gravel #cycling #snoqualmie #pnw #foginthetrees

p-4108.author: bmartinez
p-4108.image: A loaf of sourdough with a deep ear, scored in a wheat pattern, on a cooling rack
p-4108.text: Kevin (the starter) did his best work today. 78% hydration, 20 hour cold proof, scored with the wheat pattern I have been failing for a year. The ear! Look at the ear. #sourdough #homebaking #breadstagram

p-4109.author: roam.with.rin
p-4109.image: Yellow tram number 28 climbing a narrow tiled street in Lisbon at golden hour
p-4109.text: Lisbon, tram 28, the one everyone tells you to skip. Took it anyway at 7am and had it nearly to myself. The tiles are the point. Three more weeks in Portugal then a train somewhere. #lisbon #portugal #slowtravel #tram28 #goldenhour

p-4110.author: pnw.trailheads
p-4110.image: Larches turning gold around a turquoise alpine lake, Maple Pass loop
p-4110.text: LARCH REPORT: Maple Pass is at peak as of this weekend. Go early, the lot is full by 7. Trail is clear, no snow yet. Take a photo, then put the phone away for a minute. #larchmarch #maplepass #northcascades #hiking #wta

p-4111.author: northstarhq
p-4111.image: A rectangular sheet cake decorated to look like a rendered frame, with a tiny cursor made of icing
p-4111.text: We shipped Atlas 1.0 this week and the cake is, by request, a rectangle. Two years of work. Enormously proud of this team. #atlas #launchday #northstar #seattletech

p-4112.author: alicechen
p-4112.image: Team crowded around a whiteboard covered in boxes and arrows, someone holding cake
p-4112.text: The whiteboard survived the launch. We did not erase it. Nobody is allowed to erase it. #atlas #northstar #shipped

p-4113.author: carolnk
p-4113.image: Two engineers asleep in office beanbags with laptops closed, a dog between them
p-4113.text: Post-launch. Miso is providing emotional support. I am providing Friday off. #atlas #northstar #teamnap

p-4114.author: lena.frames
p-4114.image: A ferry deck at dusk, one child pressed against the rail watching the city lights
p-4114.text: Bainbridge ferry, 7:15pm crossing. She stayed at the rail the entire way while her parents argued about parking. Some people are just built to look. #ferry #seattle #streetphotography #dusk #puget sound

p-4115.author: driftwood.cafe
p-4115.image: Grey tabby cat asleep in a sunbeam on the cafe windowsill next to a stack of newspapers
p-4115.text: Nimbus (visiting, not ours, we have asked him to leave and he has declined) in his Thursday spot. He is, we are told, famous now. #cafecat #fremont #nimbus #sunbeam

p-4116.author: okafor.shoots
p-4116.image: Aurora borealis, green and violet curtains over a dark lake with pine silhouettes
p-4116.text: The aurora came south again last night and this time I was ready. Lake Wenatchee, 11pm to 1am, 8 seconds at ISO 3200. If you missed it, the forecast says one more night. Workshop dates for October in bio. #aurora #northernlights #lakewenatchee #nightphotography #washington

p-4117.author: bmartinez
p-4117.image: Goalkeeper gloves on wet grass next to a football, floodlights blurred in the background
p-4117.text: Lost 4-1. Saved a penalty. Only one of those facts is going in the caption and you are reading it. #sundayleague #goalkeeper #seattle #smallvictories

p-4118.author: vertical.world
p-4118.image: A row of kids in harnesses looking up at a tall lead wall, one pointing
p-4118.text: Youth team tryouts Saturday in Redmond, ages 8 to 16. No experience needed, we will teach you to fall first. Sign-up link in bio. #youthclimbing #redmond #climbinggym #tryouts

p-4119.author: roam.with.rin
p-4119.image: A tiny bakery counter in Porto with pasteis de nata cooling on a marble slab
p-4119.text: Porto. The bakery has no name on the door and the woman who runs it would like it to stay that way, so I am not tagging it. Six for two euro. I had six. #porto #portugal #pasteldenata #slowtravel #foodtravel

p-4120.author: miso.the.shiba
p-4120.image: Shiba inu in a tiny raincoat standing pointedly still on a wet sidewalk
p-4120.text: It is raining. I will not be walking. We can stand here as long as you like. #shiba #seattlerain #raincoat #protest

p-4121.author: carolnk
p-4121.image: The same shiba inu, twenty minutes later, still standing in the rain

p-4122.author: pnw.trailheads
p-4122.image: A trail closure sign at a muddy trailhead with a hand-drawn map of the detour
p-4122.text: CLOSURE: Rattlesnake Ledge upper trail closed through October for erosion repair. The lower loop is open and honestly nicer in the rain. Permit reminders: Enchantments lottery results are out. #trailclosure #rattlesnakeledge #enchantments #wta #hiking

p-4123.author: alicechen
p-4123.image: Sunrise over the Olympics from Golden Gardens beach, a single kayak on flat water
p-4123.text: Golden Gardens, 6:20am. Flat water, one kayak, the Olympics doing the thing. Took the morning off. Recommend it. #goldengardens #seattle #sunrise #olympics #kayak

p-4124.author: lena.frames
p-4124.image: Contact sheet of 36 frames from one roll, three circled in red grease pencil
p-4124.text: One roll, three keepers, which is a good roll. Prints of the Pike Place rain frame are back in stock, 8x10, DM me. #contactsheet #filmphotography #darkroom #35mm #prints

p-4125.author: driftwood.cafe
p-4125.image: A chalkboard menu reading Autumn: cardamom latte, pear and ginger scone, hot cider
p-4125.text: Autumn menu is up. The cardamom latte is back by popular demand and by one very persistent regular named Bob. #autumnmenu #fremont #cardamom #seattlecoffee

p-4126.author: bmartinez
p-4126.image: A cardamom latte with a bread roll on the side, a laptop open to a green test dashboard
p-4126.text: Persistent regular reporting in. It is very good. Tests are green. Good day. #cardamomlatte #driftwood #fremont #greenbuild

p-4127.author: okafor.shoots
p-4127.image: Group of students with tripods on a ridge at blue hour, headlamps on
p-4127.text: October night sky workshop is FULL. Waitlist open. We will do one more before the snow. Thank you all, cold hands together. #workshop #nightphotography #cascades #astrophotography

messages.text: Hi Lena, is the Pike Place rain frame still available as an 8x10? It would be a birthday present for a friend who waits in the rain a lot.
It is! Fibre paper, hand printed, $120 unframed. I can have it ready Friday. Pickup in Fremont or I can post it.
Pickup Friday is perfect. Thank you.
